::: {.di-hero}
# Free data science training, learned by building real projects.

[Data Insight fellows learn Python, statistics, and machine learning online, and publish what they build. Every dot below is one of their projects.]{.lede}
:::

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
data = FileAttachment("data/projects.json").json()
palette = ["#1B998B", "#7B4B94", "#E0A030", "#4F9FDF", "#C8455A"]
monthIndex = d => (+d.date.slice(0, 4)) * 12 + (+d.date.slice(5, 7) - 1)
start = data.posts.length ? monthIndex(data.posts[0]) : 0
end = data.posts.length ? Math.max(monthIndex(data.posts.at(-1)), monthIndex({date: new Date().toISOString()})) : 0
// Each month is a column of dots, several dots wide, so busy months stay readable.
perRow = Math.max(1, Math.floor((width / (end - start + 1)) / 3.4))
dots = {
  const counts = new Map();
  return data.posts.map(d => {
    const m = monthIndex(d), i = counts.get(m) ?? 0;
    counts.set(m, i + 1);
    return {...d, x: m - start + ((i % perRow) + 0.5) / perRow, y: Math.floor(i / perRow)};
  });
}
```

::: {.di-plot}
```{ojs}
//| echo: false
dots.length === 0
  ? html`<p class="di-plot-note">Projects will appear here once posts are added.</p>`
  : Plot.plot({
      width,
      height: Math.max(220, Math.min(360, (d3.max(dots, d => d.y) + 2) * 3.4 + 40)),
      marginLeft: 0,
      marginRight: 0,
      marginBottom: 28,
      style: {background: "transparent", color: "currentColor", fontFamily: "inherit", fontSize: "12px"},
      x: {
        domain: [0, end - start + 1],
        label: null,
        ticks: d3.range(0, end - start + 1).filter(i => (start + i) % 12 === 0),
        tickFormat: i => String(Math.floor((start + i) / 12))
      },
      y: {axis: null, domain: [0, Math.max(40, d3.max(dots, d => d.y) + 2)]},
      color: {domain: data.groups, range: palette, legend: true, style: {background: "transparent", color: "currentColor", fontFamily: "inherit", fontSize: "13px"}},
      ariaLabel: "Fellow projects published per month since 2019, one dot per project, colored by topic",
      marks: [
        Plot.ruleY([0], {stroke: "currentColor", strokeOpacity: 0.15}),
        Plot.dot(dots, {
          x: "x", y: "y", fill: "topic", r: 1.35,
          title: d => `${d.title}\n${d.author}, ${new Date(d.date).toLocaleDateString("en-US", {month: "short", day: "numeric", year: "numeric", timeZone: "UTC"})}`,
          href: d => `post/${d.slug}/`,
          tip: true
        })
      ]
    })
```
:::

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
note = {
  if (!dots.length) return "";
  const authors = new Set(dots.map(d => d.author)).size;
  const first = new Date(dots[0].date).toLocaleString("en-US", {month: "long", year: "numeric"});
  return `${dots.length.toLocaleString()} projects by ${authors} fellows since ${first}. Select a dot to read the project.`;
}
html`<p class="di-plot-note">${note}</p>`
```
